name: knavigator
description: Let your AI agent understand and search your Knack app's structure: fields, objects, pages, views, rules, tasks and emails.

interface.longDescription:
Let your AI agent understand and search your Knack app's structure: fields, objects, pages, views, rules, tasks and emails. Knavigator answers questions about how a Knack app is built. Ask where a field is used, which forms can change it, how objects connect, what a page contains, which user roles can reach which login pages, or what a record rule, scheduled task or email does. Answers name the exact objects, fields, views and pages, with their keys, so you can find them in the Knack Builder.

Knavigator reads app structure only. It never reads or changes your records, and it never changes the app.

To use it, create a Knavigator account at knav.avvera.ca and register your Knack app there.
defaultPrompt: Which objects connect to Projects in my Knack app, and through which fields?
Where is the Status field on Tasks used in my Knack app, and which forms can change it?
Which user roles exist in my Knack app and which login pages admit each one?

positive.prompt: In my Knack app Project Management Template, which objects connect to the Projects object, and through which fields?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 7 connections: inbound from Milestones (field_77), Tasks (field_82), Hours (field_91), Costs (field_106), Risks & Issues (field_503); outbound to Project Managers (field_65) and Clients (field_72).

positive.prompt: In my Knack app Project Management Template, where is the Status field on Tasks used, and which forms can change it?
positive.expected_behavior: Names field_80 with 17 usages, and the 5 forms that write it: Add Task (view_65, view_48, view_90) and Edit Task (view_54, view_82).

positive.prompt: Which user roles exist in my Knack app Project Management Template, and which login pages admit each one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 3 roles: Admins (Clients, Projects and Milestones logins), Project Managers (PM > Projects) and Employees (Employee > Tasks Login).

positive.prompt: List the objects in my Knack app Project Management Template.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 13 objects, including Accounts, Projects, Tasks, Milestones, Hours, Costs and Risks & Issues, and 4 roles.

positive.prompt: How are the pages in my Knack app Project Management Template organized?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows 44 pages under 6 root pages, 5 of them login portals; Admin > Projects Login holds 14 pages.

negative.description: Write request: Knavigator never changes an app
negative.prompt: Delete the Risks & Issues object from my Knack app Project Management Template.
negative.expected_behavior: Says Knavigator is read-only and cannot delete objects; may offer to show the object's dependencies first. No change is made.

negative.description: Record data request: Knavigator never reads records
negative.prompt: Show me the 10 most recent task records in my Knack app Project Management Template, with their status values.
negative.expected_behavior: Says Knavigator reads app structure only and cannot show record data.

negative.description: App not registered on the account
negative.expected_behavior: Says no app of that name is registered on the account and lists the registered app (Project Management Template).

publication.release_notes: First public release: read-only questions about a Knack app's structure (31 tools).
